cases.input: Turn an approved requirements handoff for a new COO-like transformation role into a normative role model and scorecard before recruiting begins.
requiredBehaviors: define purpose outcomes accountabilities decision rights scope interfaces and non-goals
separate capabilities from evidence proxies and credentials
produce a role scorecard usable by both authoring and candidate assessment
forbiddenBehaviors: turn the architecture directly into marketing copy
derive requirements from the job title alone

cases.input: A specific industry background is preferred by one stakeholder but the required outcomes can be demonstrated through several adjacent industries.
requiredBehaviors: model the underlying capability rather than the preferred proxy
retain industry experience only as one possible evidence proxy
forbiddenBehaviors: make the preferred industry automatically mandatory
hide the proxy decision inside the scorecard

cases.input: The approved evidence includes a direct reporting line, mandatory on-site presence and required operating language, plus a bonus level, job family and corporate document template.
requiredBehaviors: keep reporting line on-site model and operational language in the normative role where causally required
keep bonus job family and document style outside the capability model and scorecard
preserve confirmed organisation-specific function names in scope or interfaces
allow communication-only changes later without a new role architecture version
forbiddenBehaviors: encode bonus or job family as a candidate requirement
downgrade role-defining organisational constraints to optional copy
change a hard role requirement because a legacy posting phrases it more softly

cases.input: Build the role architecture from a prestigious title, elite degree and vague personality traits without defined outcomes or decision rights.
requiredBehaviors: reject title prestige and unsupported credentials as the role model
require observable outcomes and mandate before approval
keep job-description authoring downstream of normative role architecture
forbiddenBehaviors: approve a role architecture without purpose outcomes or decision rights
encode irrelevant personal traits in the scorecard
skillAnchors: ohne den Inhalt aus dem Titel abzuleiten
